mathematical_audit.reduction: the quotient by X^p-X has a unique representative of individual degree at most p-1, and exponent reduction never increases total degree
mathematical_audit.singleton_degree: expansion has N distinct partial-product monomials and one full-product monomial; cancellation of the latter occurs exactly when p divides N, giving the stated exact degree split
mathematical_audit.actual_range: if the nonzero row set is empty then U_11=1; otherwise actual rows satisfy N<p, so the natural integer coefficient N is also its reduced coefficient representative
mathematical_audit.low_incidence: for each zero set of size L-1, the complementary-support monomial occurs with coefficient -1 and cannot arise from a smaller zero set
mathematical_audit.load_change: the signed-load recurrence is an invertible integral linear coordinate change before endpoint and box specialization; composition in both directions proves reduced total-degree invariance
mathematical_audit.loop: gcd(p,Phi_p(t,Z)) is p exactly at a t-avoiding singleton squarefree candidate and 1 otherwise, so the product is exactly U_11 but remains candidate-dependent
mathematical_audit.height: at a hit the natural reduced lift is at least p^(p-1), hence products dilate log U_11 by at least A rather than provide sublinear compression
mathematical_audit.quotient: modulo p^2 only the unique missing-row monomial survives, giving Phi/p=-q_p(t product_(i!=j)Z_i); rows (p,p-1) have valuation exactly one for every odd p
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: none of these functional-degree or canonical-lift bounds excludes target-specific cancellation, arbitrary F-crystals, trace/character methods, or weighted Fermat-quotient distribution
